{{Quote|The peko peko egg omelet is very good here, and they have fresh brul juice.''"<br />"''That sounds lovely.|Ivaar Workan and Abeloth|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Brul juice''' was served fresh at [[The Nook]], a small, fashionable [[Restaurant/Legends|breakfast diner]] near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At the time of [[Ivaar Workan]] and [[Abeloth]]'s rendezvous at the diner, restaurants on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] sourced [[brul]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] from the world [[Xilxash]] due to their popularity.<ref name="Ascension" />
